payload.title: Proxy Database Forensics
payload.summary: This notebook aims to identify the differences and similarities between two proxy databases using the `cfr.ProxyDatabase` class. By comparing these databases, the notebook seeks to understand how variations in proxy data inputs can affect the quality of paleoclimate reconstructions. The analysis involves loading proxy databases, plotting their data, comparing record identifiers, and examining start times of records to pinpoint problematic records that may impact reconstruction outcomes.
goals: Identify differences between two proxy databases.
Understand the impact of proxy data variations on paleoclimate reconstructions.
Pinpoint problematic records affecting reconstruction quality.
